eyebrow: The corrected NetworkPolicy (now inside the chart)
code:
# charts/grain-ingest/templates/networkpolicy.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: grain-ingest-allow-sql
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: {{ .Values.labels.app }}   # was hand-typed "ingest"; now shared
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
    - to: [{ ipBlock: { cidr: {{ .Values.azureSqlCidr | quote }} } }]
      ports: [{ protocol: TCP, port: 1433 }]
caption: Deployment and NetworkPolicy now read the exact same label value.
